papers_read.title_as_printed: Deep learning combining FDG-PET and neurocognitive data accurately predicts MCI conversion to Alzheimer's dementia 3-year post MCI diagnosis (Cao et al., Neurobiol Dis 2023)
Explainable Machine Learning with Pairwise Interactions for Predicting Conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Utilizing Multi-Modalities Data (Cai et al., Brain Sci 2023)

what_each_reports.P-81: ADNI, 257 MCI (164 stable, 93 converting within 3 years) plus 150 CN and 205 AD for pre-training; 3D CNN on whole-brain FDG-PET with age and five cognitive scores (CDRSB, LDEL, MMSE, mPACCdigit, mPACCtrailsB), transfer learning from AD vs CN; 5-fold CV on validation sets: best AUC 0.7849 +/- 0.0963, balanced accuracy 0.7326 +/- 0.0978 for conversion within 3 years. No amyloid/tau data.
what_each_reports.P-211: ADNI, 1,042 amnestic MCI; Explainable Boosting Machine with FreeSurfer MRI volumes/thicknesses (hippocampus, amygdala, entorhinal, inferior temporal), cognitive scores (ADAS13, MMSE, FAQ, CDRSB), age, sex, education, baseline EMCI/LMCI label and APOE4; SMOTE, 90/10 split with 5-fold CV. Five-year prediction: accuracy 85%, AUC 0.92 (Comb a). AUC is lowest at 3 years; on the 3-year test set with interactions accuracy 0.75, AUC 0.81.

quantity_a: ROC-AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 3 years, from baseline FDG-PET plus age and five cognitive scores, ADNI, 5-fold CV.
quantity_b: ROC-AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 5 years, from baseline structural MRI regional measures plus cognitive scores, demographics, baseline MCI stage and APOE4, ADNI.
incompatible_if_same: No. The recorded figures are at different horizons (3 vs 5 years), and P-211 itself shows AUC varying with horizon (lowest at 3 years). At the matched 3-year horizon P-211 reports test AUC 0.81, which lies inside P-81's 0.785 +/- 0.096, so the two are compatible where they are closest to the same quantity.

gates.dataset_family: match: ADNI (overlapping MCI participants likely; P-81 uses ADNI1/GO/2, P-211 ADNI1/GO/2/3)
gates.validation_tier: match: V2 internal (CV / internal split) in both
gates.modality_family: mismatch: FDG-PET (P-81) vs structural MRI FreeSurfer measures (P-211); the record's 'Neuroimaging' bucket hides this, and both also include cognitive scores

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible for the recorded pair: same metric type (ROC-AUC) but different horizon (3-year vs 5-year conversion) and different predictor sets (FDG-PET + 5 cognitive scores vs MRI volumes + ADAS13/MMSE/FAQ/CDRSB + APOE4 + baseline EMCI/LMCI label)
performance_validity: flag does not apply: AUC 0.785 and 0.92 (below 0.97). Note P-81's AD-vs-CN pre-training models with cognitive scores reached 1.000, which the authors attribute to circularity, but that is not the contested conversion figure.
independence: Distinct studies and authors; both draw on ADNI so participant overlap is likely but not quantified.
grounds: P-81's 0.785 is a 3-year conversion AUC from FDG-PET plus cognitive scores.
P-211's 0.92 is a 5-year conversion AUC from structural MRI measures plus cognitive, demographic and APOE4 features, and the paper shows AUC depends on horizon.
Horizon, imaging modality and predictor set all differ, so the 0.135 gap is not a disagreement on one quantity.
At the matched 3-year horizon, P-211's test AUC of 0.81 falls within P-81's reported spread, so even the closest comparable figures agree.

evidence_quotes.quote: the best model was a combination of FDG-PET, age, and neurocognitive data, yielding an AUC of 0.785 ± 0.096 and a balanced accuracy of 0.733 ± 0.098.
predict if a patient with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) will convert to dementia within three years of their baseline diagnosis.
The five-years prediction accuracy reached 85% (AUC = 0.92) using both cognitive scores and MRI markers.

The mean AUC using Comb (a) displayed a characteristic pattern of first at about 0.9, then decreasing, reaching a low point at 3 years, followed by a gradual increase until 5 years of follow-up, to about 0.92.
The main performance indicators, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and AUC, were 0.75, 0.78, 0.73, and 0.81 (with interaction effects)

record_defects: The record treats 0.785 vs 0.92 as the same T2 quantity without noting the horizon difference (3-year vs 5-year).
modality_family 'Neuroimaging' conflates FDG-PET (P-81) with structural MRI measures (P-211).
Pack registry row gives P-211 Sample_N_Approx '242804'; the paper includes 1,042 aMCI patients.
Pack registry row gives P-81 Modality 'MRI/PET'; the model input is FDG-PET (MRI used only for skull-stripping masks), plus cognitive scores.
The resolution_note's bridging entries (e.g. P-764 C-index, P-876 bACC) mix metric types and explain no condition separating these two results.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A study reporting 3-year conversion AUC on ADNI from comparable inputs with uncertainty excluding P-81's 0.785 +/- 0.096; P-211's own 3-year figure (0.81) does not.
